description: This Java source file defines a test step implementation class 'LoanChargeStepDef' for testing loan charge functionalities in the Apache Fineract project. It includes methods for adding various types of charges to loans, checking charge statuses, handling waivers, and related test assertions, primarily used in Cucumber-based BDD tests.

classes.name: LoanChargeStepDef
classes.description: This class implements step definitions for testing loan charges in Fineract using Cucumber. It contains methods to add various charges, verify charge statuses, handle waivers, and validate error cases within loan-related scenarios.

methods.name: addChargeDueDate
methods.description: Adds a due date charge to a loan, given the charge type, date, and amount.

methods.name: addChargePercentage
methods.description: Adds a percentage-based charge to a loan, specifying the charge type and percentage of transaction amount.

methods.name: addInstallmentFeeCharge
methods.description: Adds an installment fee charge with a specified amount to a loan.

methods.name: addInstallmentFeeChargeFails
methods.description: Verifies that adding a certain installment charge fails with the expected error.

methods.name: addChargeDueDateOnChargedOff
methods.description: Attempts to add a charge on a charged-off account and expects failure.

methods.name: addProcessingFee
methods.description: Adds a processing fee to the loan with specified amount, locale, and date.

methods.name: addNSFfee
methods.description: Adds an NSF fee due to payment bounce for the loan.

methods.name: undoWaiveForCharge
methods.description: Reverts the waiver for a charge.

methods.name: loanChargeStatus
methods.description: Verifies that a charge has been successfully added to the loan.

methods.name: checkLoanChargeAmount
methods.description: Checks that the charge amount matches the expected value.

methods.name: chargeOffTransactionError
methods.description: Verifies that a charge-off transaction results in the expected error code and message.
